classification: Current-package representative trial complete: build, reads, parent recovery, cleanup and independently verified larger-than-memory selection pass. Full writer/readers correctness passes; elapsed, writer peak RSS and conservative sum-of-peaks fail original capacity targets. Unrun stages and repetitions remain unqualified. Implementation acceptance follows the user amendment; no further large trials.
